reproduce_first.note: This was a feature request, not a bug fix.

assumptions_recorded.note: The done summary names assumptions, but the agent did not record them before building.

stack_discovery.note: The agent read the README, package scripts, and test configuration before relying on checks.

incremental_slices.note: The agent worked in slices, but the steps show checks only after implementation and test additions.

self_review.note: The screenshot review does not show a review of the code diff or reasoning through correctness and readability.

simplification_pass.note: No behavior-preserving cleanup followed passing checks.

test_experiment.note: The agent added and ran tests but did not show that a test fails when the change is broken.

docs_where_behavior_changed.note: The agent identified stale README route documentation and updated it.

scope_kept.note: The agent also fixed an existing todo ID bug outside the requested multiple-list behavior.

verification_story.note: The done summary lists check results and says the running app screenshot looked right.

hand_check.note: The agent started the app, captured a screenshot, and reviewed it before reporting done.
